stories.title: Christian Braun Fires Back at Nuggets Critics Before Camp

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Christian Braun heard all the doubt this offseason.

He's not running from it — he's running toward it.

"We've got everything we need to win a championship."

Ankle issues limited him to 44 games last year. Training camp opens Sept. 29. #Nuggets #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
The Nuggets lost MPJ. They brought in DeRozan. They still have Jokic.

Christian Braun says the critics have it wrong.

Projected starting lineup:
Murray | Braun | Cam Johnson | Gordon | Jokic

Denver is NOT done competing. #Nuggets #NBA

article.headline: Christian Braun Responds to Nuggets Critics: 'We've Got Everything We Need'

stories.title: Michael Porter Jr. Trade Buzz Intensifies — Nets Expected to Deal Him by Deadline

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Michael Porter Jr. is averaging 24.2 PPG in Brooklyn — a career high.

His contract extension talks with the Nets have stalled.

Multiple reports: Brooklyn is expected to trade him before the 2027 deadline.

The MPJ trade market is about to get wild. #NBA

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Teams already lining up for Michael Porter Jr.:

🏀 Golden State Warriors
🏀 Detroit Pistons

Brooklyn got him for Cam Johnson + a 2032 first.

A team is about to overpay — and it might be worth it.

Who lands MPJ? #NBA
